facts.fact: USAID's HealthIT grant, per its IATI record, committed US$22,528,318 over 2016-2021 (US$22,520,057 disbursed) to support DHIS2 implementation and use for health data collection, analysis and reporting and to strengthen Kenya's health management information system; the record names no domestic funding.

The IATI record of USAID's HealthIT grant (2016-2021) describes DHIS2 in Kenya as used for health data collection, analysis and reporting at district and national level; it does not mention entry at facilities.

systems.country_label: District Health Information System II; health management information system
